Carry/bearing is historical; mark semantic extension to state. Cross-review: MW p.44 directly lists -phoria bearing; state; tendency and euphoria. Taber’s independently defines the state/tendency sense and also directly lists euphoria. American Heritage defines present-day euphoria as great happiness or well-being; Etymonline documents historical Greek euphoros bearing well and the later ordinary, nontechnical sense.
